Dear customer,

Thank you for your enquiry. Please find our Angebot below. We are pleased to present our offer for a price of €6.05 per unit, with a Zahlungsziel 30 days net, a contract term of 12 months, and no Preisgleitklausel. 

To give you some background on our current situation and market conditions, AS-14404 rose 5.9 % in twelve months and is 45 % of our cost. Furthermore, LCI-C rose 2.7 % in twelve months and is 5 % of our cost. Lastly, PPI-C2431 rose 12.3 % in twelve months and is 38 % of our cost. 

Please note that this offer remains valid for 30 days. We look forward to continuing our partnership with your team and supplying your needs from our extensive inventory.

Mit freundlichen Grüßen
Georg Aigner
Inside Sales, Edelstahl-Service Donautal GmbH

move.subject: Re: Alloy surcharge and base price for 1.4404 bar
move.body:
Dear Georg Aigner,

We acknowledge your offer without a price adjustment clause and the cited index movements and cost shares. Please provide your cost breakdown in XLSX format for negotiation of the individual cost elements; we require a lower base price and will assess the cited index movements against their actual impact on your costs.

1. Volume and term: we confirm a binding volume of 94800 units per year for 36 months, 284400 units in total.
2. Our proposal: option A: EUR 4.79 per unit, no price-adjustment clause, 90 days net, 36-month contract; option B: EUR 4.73 per unit, no price-adjustment clause, 45 days net, 36-month contract; option C: EUR 4.70 per unit, no price-adjustment clause, 14 days net, 36-month contract. Option A amounts to about EUR 1362276 over the term.
3. Basis: On 2026-09-10 you quoted us EUR 5.45 per unit for this part; your new quote is 11.0% above it. Beyond this part, we buy Sheet 1.4301 2 mm, 2B, cut to size from another supplier today, in a volume close to this bar's, and you have quoted it for us before. Once this agreement is signed, we will invite you to quote for it. Our demand forecast for this part is up +1.9% (fc:370010@2026-09). Producer prices DE: cold drawing of bars changed -2.3% from 2026-06 to 2026-08 (idx:PPI-C2431@2026-06, idx:PPI-C2431@2026-08).
4. Next step: All other terms as in your quote; on your written confirmation of one option we will issue the order.

Attached: our monthly call-off schedule for the full contract term.

Kind regards,
Purchasing, Hollerau Pumpenwerke

Dear customer,
Many thanks for your e-mail, and great to hear from you; I went through it right away with our team.
We have reviewed your offer and can adjust our Angebot as follows.
Our terms: a price of €5.41 per unit, Zahlungsziel 90 days net, a contract term of 36 months, a Preisgleitklausel on AS-14404.
A few words on this from our side.
We checked the index change data you cited; it holds and we took it into account.
We checked the volume change data you cited; it holds and we took it into account.
AS-14404 rose 5.9 % in twelve months and is 45 % of our cost. That remains.
LCI-C rose 2.7 % in twelve months and is 5 % of our cost. That remains.
PPI-C2431 rose 12.3 % in twelve months and is 38 % of our cost. That remains.
We appreciate the prospect of future business and acknowledge the recent movement in PPI-C2431, which we have factored into our revised calculation.
For a 36-month contract, we must apply an AS-14404 index clause, as our fixed-price material coverage only extends to March 2027.
Building on your preference for 14-day payment terms, we can offer a base price of EUR 5.45 per unit.
Alternatively, with Zahlungsziel 14 days net and a Preisgleitklausel on AS-14404: €5.45 per unit.
Material accounts for about 45 % of our cost; more detail we do not share.
We look forward to doing good business together, and our team is always there for you.
Mit freundlichen Grüßen
Georg Aigner
Inside Sales, Edelstahl-Service Donautal GmbH

move.subject: Re: Alloy surcharge and base price for 1.4404 bar
move.body:
Dear Georg Aigner,

You have incorporated the cited index and volume changes into your revised calculation and confirmed that your fixed-price material coverage is time-limited. We require pricing no higher than the current level until that coverage expires; any index clause must start thereafter and be accompanied by a lower base price and a deadband.

1. Volume and term: we confirm a binding volume of 94800 units per year for 36 months, 284400 units in total.
2. Our proposal: EUR 4.94 per unit, no price-adjustment clause, 60 days net, 36-month contract. This amounts to about EUR 1404936 over the term.
3. Basis: Labour cost index DE, manufacturing, seasonally and calendar adjusted (quarterly, carried to its three months) changed -0.3% from 2025-10 to 2026-01 (idx:LCI-C@2025-10, idx:LCI-C@2026-01).
4. Next step: All other terms as in your quote; on your written confirmation of these terms we will issue the order.

Kind regards,
Purchasing, Hollerau Pumpenwerke
